name: Microscopy Time-Lapse Formatting
description:
Process a raw 5D microscopy dataset into a presentation-ready video format.

1. Open the 'Mitosis' sample (File > Open Samples > Mitosis). This is a 5D hyperstack (2 channels, 5 Z-slices, 51 timeframes).

2. Perform a Maximum Intensity Z-Projection to collapse the Z-slices into 2D images (Image > Stacks > Z Project... > Max Intensity).

3. Split the channels (Image > Color > Split Channels) and keep ONLY the Red channel (Channel 1, Chromatin). Close the Green channel.

4. Create a Sub-stack containing only the first 20 timepoints (frames 1-20).

5. Add a timestamp to the video (Image > Stacks > Time Stamper):
   - Start: 00:00
   - Interval: 15.00 seconds
   - Location: Top Left
   - Font size: ~20-25

6. Save the final result as a TIFF stack to '~/ImageJ_Data/processed/mitosis_movie_formatted.tif'.
